end.summary:
Counted sides and corners of triangles and rectangles.
Counted triangle sides using corner-to-corner tracing.
Identified rectangles as having 4 sides and 4 corners.
Identified triangles as having 3 sides and 3 corners, including rotated shapes.
Teach-back was not passed; shape naming from sides and corners needs more practice.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides by moving from one corner to the next and checking the return to the starting corner. Ayaan explained that a rectangle has 4 sides and 4 corners, and a triangle has 3 of each; they also recognised that turning a shape does not change its sides. They mixed up the shape name when using sides and corners, and this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask Ayaan to trace triangles and rectangles with a finger, count the sides and corners, then name each shape.
